{{Quote|Jacen and I are going to go down the beach and look for sea motes. Okay?”''<br />''"Okay. But don’t go out of sight. If you can’t see me, I can’t see you.|Han Solo and Jaina Solo on a Illafian Point's north beach|<ref name="SOL" />}}
'''Rathalay''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="TEAOC" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] known for its gray basalt beaches, which were seldom visited by tourists. Rathalay's vast [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] harbored dangerous predators, including schools of sharp-toothed [[narkaa]].<ref name="CE">{{CSWECite|III|82|Rathalay}}</ref> Tiny [[seamote]]s lived in the surf,<ref name="SOL" /> and their jewel-like shells were highly valued. In addition to its jeweled crustaceans and quiet beaches,<ref name="CE" /> the planet also exported [[Rathalayan firestone]]s, stones that generated heat when rubbed together like [[Gallian firestone]]s.<ref name="Med" />

Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Octavian Grant|Grant]], as part of his agreement to defect to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], was allowed to retire to a villa on Rathalay,<ref name="Who who">{{InsiderCite|66|Who's Who: Imperial Grand Admirals}}</ref> where [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Jan Ors]] maintained a close eye on his activities.<ref name="The Dark Forces Saga 2">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050407b|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 2: Unsung Heroes of the Light}}</ref> News broadcasts always covered any parties Grant hosted at his private estate in society sections, bringing further interest to the resort world.<ref name="Intrigue">''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]''</ref>

Rathalay also housed the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] king [[Kaerobani]] and his [[Lumini pirates/Legends|Lumini Pirates]]. The marauders operated from a [[Kaerobani's base|planetary base]] and an [[Orbiting Ship Yards|orbital shipyard]]. The pirate leader kept [[drugon]] fish at his terrestrial base, swimming around his trophy room.<ref name="MOTS" /> In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">According to the opening crawl, ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' takes place five [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]] after the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''Jedi Knight'' to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Therefore, ''Mysteries of the Sith'' takes place in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].</ref>  [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] [[Seizure of the Jedi holocron|retrieved]] a stolen [[Kaerobani's holocron|holocron]] and escaped in a stolen ship.<ref name="MOTS" />

In [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]],<ref name="VacayDate">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' dated the events of the [[Solo family/Legends|Solo family]] vacation to twelve years after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dated [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], therefore it occurred during [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]].</ref> the [[Solo family/Legends|Solo family]] took a brief vacation to the northern beaches of [[Illafian Point]] during the [[Black Fleet Crisis]] to escape [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo's]] political responsibilities.<ref name="SOL" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rathalay first appeared in the [[1996]] abridged audiobook [[Shield of Lies (abridged audiobook)|''Shield of Lies'']], written by [[Michael P. Kube-McDowell]].<ref name="SOL" /> The [[2010]] game supplemental ''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]'' incorrectly identified Rathalay as an [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] world.<ref name="Intrigue" />
